# mergeah_tool_access_requests (Data Source)

Read Merge Agent Handler tool_access_requests. Results are available as JSON via response_json; paginated collections are fetched completely.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Configure the provider as shown in examples/provider/provider.tf.
data "mergeah_tool_access_requests" "example" {
}

locals {
  tool_access_requests = jsondecode(data.mergeah_tool_access_requests.example.response_json)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `query` (Map of String) Additional documented API query parameters. All pages are fetched automatically. Values must be strings.
- `registered_user_id` (String) Filter to one Registered User's requests.
- `search` (String) Case-insensitive match on requester name, reason, decision note, tool slug, or connector name.
- `status` (String) Filter by status: `pending`, `approved`, `denied`, `revoked`, `canceled`, or `expired`. `approved` returns only approvals that have not expired; `expired` returns approvals whose expiry has passed.

### Read-Only

- `response_json` (String, Sensitive) JSON object for a detail endpoint, or JSON array containing every item for a collection. Use jsondecode to read fields. Sensitive because API records may contain personal data.
